text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm Fine Motion. I'll be in your care from 
now on, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
My wish is... to make lo~ts and lots of 
wonderful memories with everyone, yeah♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to give my all in racing 
too. I want to walk through an 
unforgettable three years together with 
you!

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
